svg.title: Asset types: what the scheduler plans for
svg.desc: The six kinds of physical asset in the garage: how each is identified, which message holds its state, where it sits, which event changes it in the plan, which command executes it, and its footprint id.

g.text: All six live in DiscreteGarageState (agvs, trays, payloads, bays, vexen, vrcs). Fixed assets (bay, VECS, VRC) are also layout nodes; mobile ones (AGV, tray, payload) are not: they have a pose. GarageEntityId

g.text: Asset types: what the scheduler plans for

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Six kinds of physical asset. Three move (AGV, tray, payload) and three are fixed in the layout (bay, VECS, VRC). Each row says which type in the code stands for that asset.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
